title: This or that
summary: Quick two-choice questions that get the chat typing.
steps: Ask a fun two-choice question (coffee or tea, beach or mountains).
Read answers out loud and react to names.
Turn the winning answer into a small goal or a story.
prompts: + Quick one: beach night or cosy movie night? 👀
+ This or that: dancing or storytime next?

title: Tipper's choice song
summary: Let tippers pick the next song. Easy, low-pressure engagement.
steps: Announce that a small tip picks the next song.
Play it, dance or sing along, and thank the tipper by name.
Use it as a bridge back into the main goal.
prompts: + Next song is up to you. Tip to pick it! 🎶

title: Spin the wheel
summary: A random wheel of small, fun actions keeps slow rooms moving.
steps: Prepare a wheel with 6–8 light actions (a pose, a dance move, a joke).
Each spin costs a small tip.
Build up the suspense before each result.
